content.short: Chess of Art is an NFT marketplace built on the Cardano Blockchain with the mechanism of unlocking a new age of NFT utilities.
content.description:
Chess of Art is an NFT marketplace built on the Cardano Blockchain with the mechanism of unlocking a new age of NFT utilities to users and also aims to be the CNFT utility service provider in Africa.

Our goal is to unlock a new age of NFT utilities to users by supporting early-stage Cardano NFT projects building on real-world use cases by funding, not only by funding them but by offering our community the power to decide by vote what project the allocation should be made to and in return be rewarded to committing to the decentralization of the Cardano Network.
